message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling:

| Title | Year Published | Genre | Notable Facts |
|-------|----------------|-------|---------------|
| **Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone** (also known as *Sorcerer’s Stone* in the U.S.) | 1997 | Fantasy | First book in the Harry Potter series; introduced the wizarding world. |
| **Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets** | 1998 | Fantasy | Introduces the mystery of the Chamber and the basilisk. |
| **Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban** | 1999 | Fantasy | Features the escape of Sirius Black and the introduction of the Marauder’s Map. |
| **Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire** | 2000 | Fantasy | The Triwizard Tournament and the return of Voldemort. |
| **Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix** | 2003 | Fantasy | Focuses on the formation of Dumbledore’s Army and the Ministry’s denial of Voldemort’s return. |
| **Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince** | 2005 | Fantasy | Explores Voldemort’s backstory and the discovery of Horcruxes. |
| **Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows** | 2007 | Fantasy | Concludes the series with the final battle at Hogwarts. |
| **The Casual Vacancy** | 2012 | Contemporary Fiction | Rowling’s first adult novel, dealing with social issues in a small town. |
| **The Cuckoo’s Calling** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2013 | Crime/Thriller | First book in the Cormoran Strike detective series. |
| **The Silkworm** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2014 | Crime/Thriller | Second book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Career of Evil** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2015 | Crime/Thriller | Third book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **Lethal White** (as Robert Galbraith) | 2018 | Crime/Thriller | Fourth book in the Cormoran Strike series. |
| **The Ickabog** | 2020 | Children’s Fantasy | A fairy‑tale style story about a mythical beast. |

These titles span Rowling’s most famous works, from the Harry Potter saga to her adult novels and the Cormoran Strike detective series.
